image_description: A high-angle, close-up shot of a scattered collection of disposable plastic lighters on a dark blue surface. The lighters vary in color (green, pink, purple, blue, white) and orientation. Several lighters are lit, producing small yellow-orange flames. The bodies are translucent or opaque plastic with metal wind guards and ignition wheels visible.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Compact handheld device sized to fit comfortably within a closed palm.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The objects are clearly identifiable as standard disposable lighters, which by definition and visual proportion relative to each other fit the 'handheld' description.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Rectangular or cylindrical body with hinged lid or fixed top.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: All visible items exhibit the characteristic rectangular prism shape with rounded corners typical of disposable lighters. They have fixed tops (no flip-top lids seen, but fixed top is an allowed variant).

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Flame emerges from small metal tube at top when activated.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Multiple lighters are active, and flames are visibly originating from the nozzle area protected by the metal wind guard.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Flint wheel or piezoelectric button ignition mechanism.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The serrated flint wheels are clearly visible on the sides of the metal assemblies of several lighters (e.g., the central green one, the pink one on the right).

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Fuel nozzle producing flame from internal reservoir.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The flame emergence point corresponds to the location of the fuel nozzle within the metal wind guard structure.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Hinged flip-top lid or fixed top with spark wheel.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The lighters feature fixed tops with integrated spark wheels, matching the 'fixed top' criterion.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Metal or plastic casing with brushed chrome or colored enamel finish.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The bodies are clearly plastic (translucent and opaque colors), and the tops are metal. This matches the material description.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Internal butane or lighter fluid reservoir.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: While implied by the function, the internal reservoir itself is not directly visible as a distinct component separate from the plastic casing; we only see the outer shell.
The context and object type confirm portability.

artifact_observations.reasoning: There is printed text/logo on the translucent green lighter that appears slightly distorted and illegible, typical of AI generation struggling with small text rendering.
The flames have a slightly 'painted' or overly smooth gradient look rather than the chaotic transparency of real fire, though it is subtle.
Some contact shadows between the lighters and the blue surface are soft or slightly inconsistent, causing minor floating sensations, but no severe melting.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the specific class identity of the objects as 'lighter' and distinguish from similar cylindrical objects.
To rigorously evaluate the legibility and structural integrity of the text/logos printed on the plastic bodies, which showed signs of gibberish.
To assess the realism of the semi-transparent plastic materials and the physics/appearance of the generated flames.

focus_areas: Realism of flame transparency and shape
Consistency of metal vs plastic material rendering
Contact shadows and grounding of multiple objects
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the text auditor's findings. If the text is completely nonsensical or melted into the plastic, increase artifact severity. Check if the perceptual quality auditor flags the flames as looking like solid geometry rather than light emission.
